payload.title: Console reads the head-stage index (board columns and refresh)
payload.description: components/news-desk-taxonomy-client.ts: loadNewsroomContentItemStagePage and loadNewsroomContentItemsChangedSince query listItemsByHeadStageAndUpdatedAt (tenant-scoped key) instead of listItemsByStageAndUpdatedAt with the superseded filter. lib/board-refresh.ts applyChangedVersions drops every loaded row whose lineage appears among the changed rows (a lineage has one head, so a changed head replaces whatever was shown for it); latestVersionPerContentItem stays only as a defence against a duplicate head. Ships after the backfill has run on the site (the release is a front-end bump). Acceptance: the board scenarios pass; on MoM every column reads exactly its heads (no filter, no extra pages); 0 cards show a non-head version.
